title.rendered: REVISED: Board of Directors/City Council Joint Work Session – April 19, 2023

content.rendered:
UPDATE (04/17/23) Please note that the agenda for this meeting has been revised to include two additional topics. Revised agenda can be viewed at the link below.

The SSD Board of Directors and the Sherwood City Council will meet in a Joint Work Session on Wednesday, April 19, 2023, starting at 6:00pm at the District Office Board Room (21920 SW Sherwood Blvd). For meeting agenda, click here. For meeting livestream, visit our District YouTube channel at https://bit.ly/39VlhD3
